battle.name: 韓戰
battle.brief: 一九五〇年六月二十五日北韓越過三八線攻南，聯合國軍退守釜山，仁川登陸後反攻，同年十月底中國志願軍渡鴨綠江，戰線在清川江一線被拉平。本卡M26潘興坦克是美軍第四坦克營唯一裝配的重型戰車，負責正面突破與掩護步兵，卻因傳動與行走裝置頻頻故障，在清川江與長津湖的攻勢中未能扭轉戰局。

kit.name: M26潘興坦克
kit.history: 1944年列裝的美軍重型坦克，韓戰期間配屬地面部隊，用於近距火力支援與對抗對方中型坦克。

countries: 這場戰爭是二戰之後第一場大規模的冷戰代理戰，交戰方分成三大集團。北方是朝鮮人民軍：一九四八年九月在蘇聯軍事顧問團指導下組建，金日成自任最高司令，總參謀長金策掌握作戰計畫，全軍以步兵師為骨架，配屬蘇制T-34/85坦克、機關槍與迫擊砲，初期即以縱隊越過三八線展開縱深突擊。跟進加入的是中國人民志願軍：毛澤東與周恩來拍板出兵規模，林彪以第十三兵團改編成軍，彭德懷任司令員兼政治委員，洪學智任參謀長，鄧華與韓先楚先後輔佐指揮，第38、第39、第40、第42、第43、第50與第66軍等師旅陸續開赴前線，首批約二十五萬人於一九五〇年十月十九日渡過鴨綠江。南方則是聯合國軍：以南韓陸軍為主，並有英國、加拿大、澳洲、紐西蘭、印度、南非、法國、比利時、盧森堡、土耳其、希臘、菲律賓與泰國等國派遣的部隊，總指揮是道格拉斯·麥克阿瑟；美軍由第八集團軍作戰，沃克與里奇韋先後接掌，愛德蒙·艾爾蒙指揮第十軍，約翰尼·沃克的第1騎兵師是機動打法的核心。蘇聯與中國在背後提供空軍指導、志願航空兵飛行員與後勤支援，卻避免同聯合國軍直接交戰。
countriesEn: The war was the first large-scale Cold War proxy conflict after the Second World War, and the belligerents fall into three camps. In the north stood the Korean People's Army, founded in September 1948 under the guidance of Soviet military advisers, with Kim Il Sung as supreme commander and Chief of the General Staff Kim Chaek in charge of operational planning. Its infantry divisions were backed by Soviet T-34/85 tanks, machine guns and mortars, and it opened the war with a deep offensive across the 38th parallel in column after column. The second bloc to enter was the Chinese People's Volunteers: Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai settled the scale of the intervention, Lin Biao converted the 13th Army Group for the task, Peng Dehuai served as commander and political commissar and Hong Xuezhi as chief of staff, with Deng Hua and Han Xianchu assisting the command. The 38th, 39th, 40th, 42nd, 43rd, 50th and 66th Armies and their attached formations moved to the front one after another, the first contingent of about 250,000 men crossing the Yalu River on 19 October 1950. The southern side was the United Nations Command, built around the Republic of Korea Army with contingents from Britain, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, South Africa, France, Belgium, Luxembourg, Turkey, Greece, the Philippines and Thailand, under the overall command of Douglas MacArthur. The American component fought as the Eighth Army, handed from Walton Walker to Matthew Ridgway, with Edward Almond commanding the X Corps and Johnnie E. Walker's 1st Cavalry Division providing the mobile striking force. Behind the lines the Soviet Union and China supplied air-force advisers, volunteer pilots and logistics, while carefully avoiding direct combat with the United Nations forces.
people: 關鍵人物可分四層。第一層是北方的決策者：金日成把朝鮮人民軍全部可用兵力一次投入三八線，志在速戰速決完成南北統一；總參謀長金策與元帥朴仁分別掌握戰術計畫與砲兵火力。第二層是中方：出兵本身經過反覆推敲，毛澤東在政治局會議上拍板，周恩來參與決策，彭德懷以志願軍司令員身分在前線調度各兵團，第38軍軍長梁興初、第39軍軍長吳信泉、第40軍軍長譚冠三、第50軍軍長曾澤生各領所部在山脊上穿插分割敵後；洪學智任參謀長，鄧華、韓先楚、楊得志、宋任窮先後出任參謀與兵團指揮。第三層是美方將領：麥克阿瑟主導九月十五日仁川登陸與十一月的「回家過聖誕」攻勢，戰局逆轉後被杜魯門解職，馬克·克拉克接任聯合國軍總司令；第八集團軍司令沃克在十二月下旬車禍身亡，愛德蒙·艾爾蒙在長津湖一線指揮兩個師冒險穿插。第四層是前線的技術型軍官：第四坦克營各連排長以M26戰車在公路上掩護騎兵撤退，第1騎兵師師長約翰尼·沃克在清川江上游與志願軍第39軍反覆對峙；里奇韋在一九五一年初以兩翼包抄的辦法在春川與原道一線奪回被佔山脊，扭轉了戰局。
peopleEn: Key figures fall into four layers. The first are the northern decision makers: Kim Il Sung committed every available soldier of the KPA to a single push across the 38th parallel in the hope of a quick unification, while chief of staff Kim Chaek and marshal Pak Il ran the tactical plan and the artillery fire. The second are the Chinese: the decision to intervene was argued over repeatedly, Mao Zedong settled it at the Politburo, Zhou Enlai took part in the discussions, and Peng Dehuai directed the armies in the field from his post as commander of the volunteers; army commanders such as Liang Xingchu of the 38th, Wu Xinquan of the 39th, Tan Guansan of the 40th and Zeng Ze-sheng of the 50th led their formations through the ridges to cut the enemy rear, with Hong Xuezhi as chief of staff and Deng Hua, Han Xianchu, Yang Dezhi and Song Renqiong taking staff and army-group posts in turn. The third layer is the American leadership: MacArthur directed the Inchon landing of 15 September and the Home-by-Christmas offensive of November, was relieved by President Truman when the war turned against the United Nations, and was succeeded as C-in-C by Mark Clark. Eighth Army commander Walton Walker was killed in a vehicle accident in late December, and Edward Almond directed two divisions in a hazardous penetration around the Chosin Reservoir. The fourth layer consists of the technical officers at the front: company and platoon leaders of the 4th Tank Battalion used M26 tanks to screen the cavalry withdrawal along the roads, Johnnie E. Walker of the 1st Cavalry Division traded blows with the 39th Army upstream of the Ch'ongch'on, and Ridgway recovered the seized ridges around Chuncheon and Wonju in early 1951 with a two-flank envelopment that turned the war.
kits: 卡面這件M26潘興是美軍一九四四年才量產的重型戰車，作戰全重約十七噸，車組五人，裝Continental R-280-7星形汽油機約五百馬力，主武器為90毫米M3戰車砲，可發射穿甲彈與榴彈，公路最高速約五十六公里，採用前後主動懸掛與扭桿行走裝置，液力變速箱與最終傳動在朝鮮山路的泥雪中故障率高。更大的T26E3改用五人大砲塔與更厚的正面裝甲，日後改名M46巴頓，正是韓戰中真正吃重的美軍主力戰車。M26在體系裡的位置很清楚：美軍第四坦克營是唯一以它為主要配備的營級單位，韓戰初期約有六七十輛，隸屬第1騎兵師等單位，負責沿公路正面突破、掩護步兵與拖曳砲兵，同時要對付對方成建制的T-34/85與由IS-2、IS-3車體改裝而成的Type 58坦克。同期出現的還有M24查菲輕坦克、M4A3E8謝爾曼、M113裝甲車、M19與M30通用裝載機、M39重卡與兩噸半六輪卡車；反坦克武器有57毫米M1與M18反戰車砲、3.5吋火箭筒與2吋火箭筒，砲兵則是81與120毫米迫擊砲。志願軍與朝鮮人民軍大量使用蘇制PPSh-41衝鋒槍、莫辛-納甘步槍、DP-27輕機槍、76毫米自行砲，以及空投與繳獲自美軍的卡車、迫擊砲與通訊器材。航空方面，聯合國軍以F-51野馬、F-80、F-86佩刀與B-29、B-26作戰，蘇聯志願航空兵則駕駛MiG-15在北方空域與美軍周旋。
kitsEn: The M26 Pershing on the card face was a heavy tank the US Army only put into production in 1944, weighing about 17.5 tonnes fully loaded, with a crew of five, a Continental R-280-7 air-cooled petrol engine of roughly 500 horsepower, and a 90 mm M3 gun firing both armour-piercing and high-explosive shells. It rode on individual torsion-bar suspension with a powered traverse, ran at about 56 km/h on the road, and its liquid transmission and final drives gave it a poor reputation for reliability in the mud and snow of Korean mountain roads. The larger T26E3 carried a five-man turret, heavier frontal armour and a longer gun, and was later redesignated as the M46 Patton, the tank that really carried the American war in Korea. The M26's place in the order of battle was clear: the US 4th Tank Battalion was the only unit equipped with it as its principal armament, and entered the war with roughly sixty to seventy vehicles, attached to formations such as the 1st Cavalry Division, tasked with frontal breach, infantry screening and towing artillery against an enemy fielded in T-34/85s and in Type 58 tanks converted from IS-2 and IS-3 hulls. Alongside them appeared M24 Chaffee light tanks, M4A3E8 Shermans, M19 and M30 universal carriers, M113 armoured personnel carriers, M39 heavy trucks, two-and-a-half-ton six-wheel lorries and five-ton half-tracks; anti-tank weapons were the 57 mm M1 and M18 guns, the 3.5 inch bazooka and the 2 inch rocket launcher, with 81 mm and 120 mm mortars for infantry. The Chinese and North Korean forces fielded PPSh-41 submachine guns, Mosin-Nagant rifles, DP-27 light machine guns, 76 mm self-propelled guns, and large quantities of trucks, mortars and communications equipment captured from the Americans and dropped by air. In the air the United Nations flew F-51 Mustangs, F-80s, F-86 Sabres, B-29s and B-26s, while Soviet volunteer pilots flew MiG-15s in the northern skies.
tactics: 北方與中方的戰術建立在壓倒性的步兵與主動進攻上：朝鮮人民軍以縱隊沿公路晝夜行軍，抵近後以密集步兵波浪式衝鋒，迫擊砲與機關槍在後方齊射支援；志願軍承襲同一思路，在縱深上做得更細，入朝初期多在夜間行軍、白天潛伏休息，班排採「三三制」編組，衝鋒組、支援組、替補組各佔三分之一，避免一次把兵力投光。美軍與聯合國軍初期吃的卻是通信與縱隊控制的虧：車隊沿單一公路推進，無線電失靈加上縱隊拉得太長，遭志願軍在雲山、龍門與清川江兩側的夜襲分割，東線英國第29旅的山道縱隊與志願軍正面撞上即告崩潰。仁川登陸改變了整個局面，一九五〇年九月十五日第1海運大隊在月尾島附近上岸，當面插入，切斷北韓縱隊的補給與退路。志願軍渡江後，第40軍在雲山夜襲美騎兵第1營，第38軍在漢江南岸與美騎兵第7團血戰，第二次戰役在東西兩線同時拉平戰線。清川江戰役是M26最後的高光也是盡頭：十一月二十四日「回家過聖誕」攻勢發動後，志願軍第39軍三個師在山脊上逐層抵抗，第四坦克營以M26在公路上掩護撤退，卻因故障接連掉隊。此後戰線固定在山脊上，雙方挖壕固守，靠砲兵與空軍近距支援消耗對方，再以夜間滲透奪取山頭制高點；美軍由此認定制空與縱深火力比正面裝備更決定勝負，遂把M26逐步換成M46與M47。
tacticsEn: Tactics on the northern and Chinese side rested on mass infantry and deliberate attack: the KPA marched in columns along the roads by day and night, then assaulted in successive waves of dense infantry while mortars and machine guns fired in support; the volunteers inherited that approach and refined it in depth, moving mostly at night, resting concealed by day, and organising each platoon on the three-thirds system in which striking, support and reserve groups each took a third of the strength so that no unit was committed all at once. The Americans and their allies at first paid for poor communications and column control: long convoys along single roads, radio failures and stretched columns were cut apart by night attacks at Yunshan, Longmen and along the Ch'ongch'on, and the mountain column of the British 29th Brigade in the east collapsed when it met the volunteers head-on. The Inchon landing of 15 September 1950 changed the picture, the 1st Amphibious Task Force going ashore near Wolmi-do to cut the northern supply lines and retreat routes. After the Yalu crossing the 40th Army struck the US 1st Cavalry Division at Yunshan at night, the 38th Army fought for the ground south of the Han River against the 7th Cavalry Regiment, and the second offensive straightened the front on both the eastern and western axes. The battle of the Ch'ongch'on was the last high point of the M26 and also its end: after the Home-by-Christmas offensive was launched on 24 November, three divisions of the 39th Army fought the ridges layer by layer, and the 4th Tank Battalion used its M26s on the roads to cover the withdrawal, only to drop out of line through mechanical failure. Thereafter the front froze along the ridges, both sides dug in, trading barrages and close air support to wear each other down and taking heights by night infiltration; the Americans concluded that air superiority and depth fire mattered more than frontal armour, and replaced the M26 with the M46 and M47 as fast as they could.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：交戰自一九五〇年六月二十五日開打，到一九五三年七月二十七日簽署停戰協定，前後約一千一百二十七天。朝鮮人民軍初期投入約六萬至七萬人，志願軍首批渡江約二十五萬人，先後入朝的官兵累積超過一百八十萬人次；聯合國軍在韓兵力高峰約八十萬至九十萬人，其中美軍約十七萬人，南韓軍佔大宗。傷亡方面，美軍死亡逾三萬六千人、受傷約十一萬人，南韓軍死亡約三萬人；朝鮮人民軍死亡多在五萬至十萬人以上，志願軍方面中方公布的作戰犧牲人數在十八萬至二十萬之間，各方統計差距很大。裝備上，第四坦克營初期約配六七十輛M26與T26E3，而M26全型只造了一百輛出頭，多數在開戰數月內即被M46取代；空戰中美軍損失F-86數百架，蘇聯與中國方面的MiG-15被擊落數逾六百架，雙方各執一詞。距離與時間上，北韓在開戰首週推進逾四百公里，仁川距漢城約三十公里，清川江至長津湖約六十公里，鴨綠江至三八線縱深超過三百公里，而韓戰全線戰壕長度以千公里計。氣候是另一組數字：長津湖一役氣溫跌至攝氏零下三十度以下，燃料、機件與傷員後送同時受阻。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these: the war ran from 25 June 1950 to the armistice signed on 27 July 1953, some 1,127 days. The North Korean army committed about 60,000 to 70,000 men in the opening offensive, the first Chinese contingent across the Yalu numbered roughly 250,000, and more than 1.8 million volunteer personnel passed through Korea over the course of the war; United Nations strength in the peninsula peaked at around 800,000 to 900,000, of which about 170,000 were American and the bulk South Korean. In losses, more than 36,500 Americans died and over 130,000 were wounded, South Korean dead numbered about 30,000, North Korean dead are put between 50,000 and more than 100,000, and Chinese official figures for volunteers killed in action fall somewhere between 180,000 and 200,000, estimates differing sharply from one accounting to the next. In materiel, the 4th Tank Battalion began the war with roughly sixty to seventy M26 and T26E3 vehicles, and no more than a hundred M26s of all types were ever built, most of them displaced by the M46 within months; in the air war hundreds of F-86s were lost by the Americans while more than six hundred MiG-15s were claimed shot down on the Soviet and Chinese side, each side arguing the numbers. In distances and times, the North Koreans advanced more than 400 kilometres in the first week, Inchon lies about 30 kilometres from Seoul, the Ch'ongch'on and the Chosin Reservoir are roughly 60 kilometres apart, the Yalu is more than 300 kilometres north of the 38th parallel, and the dug-in front ran for a thousand kilometres and more. Weather supplied the other set of numbers: in the Chosin sector the temperature fell below minus 30 degrees Celsius, and fuel, machinery and the evacuation of the wounded all failed at once.
cause: 戰爭的起因有遠因也有導火線。遠因是二戰後的分裂：一九四五年八月蘇軍進入平壤、美軍在釜山登陸，同年九月美蘇以北緯三十八度線劃分受降區，朝鮮被切成兩個佔管區；一九四八年美蘇先後撤走駐軍，朝鮮人民軍在蘇聯顧問團指導下成立，同年九月建立朝鮮民主主義人民共和國，北韓政權一直把統一視為建國第一要務，蘇聯的軍援與中國大陸的接壤也讓它相信風險可控。導火線是一九五〇年上半年的連串變化：美方把太平洋第七艦隊調入東海、並把對臺政策定為既定政策，北韓因此相信美國不會參戰；四月金日成在人民軍高幹會議上提出「國內統一」方針，五月提出南北統一方案，六月把主力推進到三八線附近準備進攻。六月二十五日北韓越線，當日聯合國安理會通過第八十三號決議判定其為侵略者，七月七日第八十四號決議授權會員國提供軍事援助，杜魯門隨後宣布介入。麥克阿瑟在珍珠港與參謀長的會談更明確表示，一旦統一政權出現在鴨綠江畔，美軍就會越過邊境作戰；而中國在仁川登陸、美軍逼近鴨綠江之後，判定無法容忍半島出現對準自己邊境的統一政權，遂決定以志願軍名義出兵，把原本的內戰改寫成兩個陣營的代理衝突。
causeEn: The war had both distant causes and an immediate trigger. The distant cause was the post-war partition: Soviet troops entered Pyongyang in August 1945 and the Americans landed at Busan, and the surrender zones were drawn along the 38th parallel, cutting the peninsula in two; when both occupiers withdrew in 1948, the Korean People's Army was organised with Soviet advisers and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was proclaimed in September of that year. Northern leadership had treated unification as the first task of the state, and Soviet military aid and the border with Chinese territory made it believe the risks were manageable. The trigger was a run of changes in the first half of 1950: the United States moved the Seventh Fleet into the East China Sea and turned its policy towards Taiwan into settled policy, and Pyongyang concluded that America would not fight; in April Kim Il Sung announced the line of internal unity at a senior officers' meeting, a unification plan for the north and south followed in May, and the main body of the army was moved up to the 38th parallel in June. On 25 June the North crossed the line, the Security Council adopted Resolution 83 the same day judging the invasion an act of aggression, Resolution 84 of 7 July authorised member states to provide military assistance, and Truman committed American forces. MacArthur told his chiefs of staff at Pearl Harbor that a united Korea on the Yalu would draw American troops across the frontier, and China, seeing the landing at Inchon and American troops nearing the Yalu, judged it intolerable to face a unified regime on the peninsula aimed at its own border, and chose to send the volunteers, converting what had been a civil war into a proxy clash between two blocs.
impact: 停火之後的世界被韓戰重新排列。最直接的是朝鮮半島的形狀：原本只是國界的那條線變成重兵對峙的軍事前線，至今雙方在山脊上維持大量部隊與地雷帶，敵對狀態從未真正終止，這條線也成了冷戰在亞洲最著名的樣板。對美國而言，韓戰是二戰後第一場大規模地面戰爭的實戰，暴露了原子彈之後仍要打常規戰的現實，代價是三萬多人性命與以一九五〇年代幣值計逾三百億美元的直接軍費；與此同時，直升機首次大規模用於傷員後送，制空權與空地協同的價值被重新評估，太空與電子戰也開始進入軍備競賽。對中國而言，朝鮮戰爭被視為立國之戰，靠一場戰爭確立了東北邊疆的安全，同時把中美關係凍結到一九七二年；對日本而言，佔領期的結束與韓戰帶來的特需訂單，加速了它的經濟復興，並在一九五一年簽下美日安全保障條約。對全球的啟示更冷：兩個大國都不會直接出手，戰爭交給代理人來打，武器與戰術在此試驗並推廣，越南戰爭的整套劇本，早已在朝鮮的冬夜山脊上演過。
impactEn: The post-armistice world was reordered by Korea. Most directly the shape of the peninsula changed: what had been a border line became a militarised front, with large armies and mine belts dug into the ridges to this day, and the state of hostility has never truly ended; that line became the most famous model of the Cold War in Asia. For the United States it was the first large ground war of the post-atom era, exposing the fact that conventional war had to be fought even after the atomic bomb, at the price of tens of thousands of dead and a direct military cost of more than thirty billion dollars in 1950s money; at the same time helicopters were used for the first time in mass for casualty evacuation, the value of air superiority and of air-ground cooperation was re-assessed, and space and electronic warfare entered the arms race. For China the war was a founding struggle that made the security of the northeastern border a matter of state, and it froze Sino-American relations until 1972. For Japan the end of occupation and the special-demand orders that followed the war quickened economic recovery, and the security treaty with the United States was signed in 1951. The wider lesson was colder: neither great power would strike directly, the fighting was handed to proxies, weapons and tactics were tested and refined on that peninsula, and the entire script of the Vietnam War had already been played out on the winter ridges of Korea.
result: 一九五三年七月二十七日，《朝鮮人民軍與中國人民志願軍同聯合國軍停戰協定》在板門簽署，軍事停火自當日起生效，戰俘交換與非軍事人員遣返拖到一九五五年才完成。結果是一條大致回到三八線附近的分界線：北方控制線略偏北，南方保有南韓全部領土，聯合國軍在戰爭末段曾把控制線推到清川江以南，最後退回原位，雙方各自佔據易守難攻的山脊陣地，沒有一方全勝，也沒有一方被徹底擊敗。聯合國軍以三年零一個月的地面戰役換回南韓的存續，志願軍完成出兵目標後於一九五八年分批撤回中國，北韓的統一目標落空，朝鮮半島的分裂則被制度化。中國同時在戰後被排除於安理會常任理事國之外，聯合國對華實施長期封鎖與禁運，國民政府在臺灣則獲得大量美援與美軍顧問支持，兩岸局勢因而被凍結。對M26這個細節而言，它的結局與整場戰爭一致：作戰可靠、數量越打越少，最後一批在韓戰初期就被M46巴頓換下，殘餘車體多數在停戰前後被拆解或改造，只在少數博物館與相關部隊的紀念館裡留下車體與編號。
resultEn: On 27 July 1953 the Armistice Agreement between the Korean People's Army and the Chinese People's Volunteers on the one side and the United Nations Command on the other was signed at Panmunjom, the military ceasefire taking effect from that day, while prisoner exchanges and the repatriation of non-combatants dragged on until 1955. The outcome was a demarcation line broadly back at the 38th parallel: the northern line sat slightly north of it, the South kept all of South Korea, and the United Nations had pushed the line south of the Ch'ongch'on late in the war before falling back to its starting position, each side holding the ridges it had made impregnable, with no complete victor and no side totally beaten. The United Nations had traded three years and one month of ground fighting to keep the South alive, the volunteers reached their objective and withdrew in stages to China by 1958, northern unification failed, and the division of the peninsula was institutionalised. At the same time China found itself shut out of the Security Council's permanent membership, the United Nations maintained its embargo and blockade against the mainland, and the Nationalist authorities on Taiwan received large American aid and advisers, freezing the cross-strait situation. The M26 fits the same pattern: reliable in action, steadily fewer in number, the last batches swapped out for M46 Pattons in the opening months of the war, with most surviving hulls stripped or rebuilt, and only a handful of vehicles and their numbers surviving in museums and regimental memorial halls.
